title: CSS — Colors & Fonts
body: CSS styles your HTML. Set color and font-size on any element via a selector.

title: CSS — Flexbox
body: display: flex turns a container into a flex row. Use gap for spacing and justify-content to align items.

title: JS — Variables
body: Use let for values that change and const for values that stay. Strings go in quotes, numbers without.

quiz.q: Which keyword makes a constant variable?

title: JS — Events
body: Events make pages interactive. addEventListener listens for clicks, key presses, etc.
